description:
Join my community & get free value. Take this short survey (takes 1 minute):  https://tally.so/r/RGXj5Q

I'll be offering a free 20-minute call for people who fill in the survey. 

I made a Vox-style data chart, a Vox-style timeline and a viral Netflix reel using only Remotion and Claude Code. No keyframes, no After Effects, and you don't need to know how to code.

In this Remotion masterclass I'll teach you everything you need to know about Remotion for motion graphics: what Remotion actually is, how to set it up (the terminal way and the easy Claude Code way), a tour of Remotion Studio, and then three full builds that go from simple to advanced.

What you'll learn:

- How Remotion turns code into video, and where it beats Premiere Pro and After Effects
- Two ways to install Remotion, including letting Claude Code set it up for you
- Remotion Studio: frames, the timeline, prop controls and rendering
- Build 1: an animated Vox-style bar chart, plus easing and a print paper look
- Build 2: a Vox-style Mac timeline with one continuous camera move and a halftone magazine finish
- Build 3: a viral reel, scene by scene, with a portal zoom, film grain and TV scanlines
- How to write prompts like specs so Claude Code builds exactly what you want

🎬Full tutorial on how I made the viral reel (voiceover done with AI): https://youtu.be/xOhh274Ayac

🛠️Tools used:
Remotion: https://www.remotion.dev
Claude Code

⏱️Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:49 What is Remotion?
3:06 Installing Remotion + Studio tour
6:50 Build 1: Vox-style data chart
11:12 Build 2: Vox-style timeline
14:24 Build 3: Viral reel

👍If this helped, like and subscribe for more. In the next video I'll show you how I edit my actual YouTube videos completely in Remotion.

#remotion #claudecode #motiongraphics
